correctness.rationale: For independent first edge arrivals the pendant-edge success event is exactly that both disjoint spine branches leave their common endpoint vacant until the pendant clock. This gives F_l(t)=1-alpha integral_0^t exp(-(alpha+beta)s)F_{l-1}(s) ds, F_0=1; the exact solution is a truncated exponential in x=alpha/(alpha+beta)(1-exp(-(alpha+beta)t)). Direct integration against the pendant exponential clock proves the finite double sum via the beta function. The alternating Taylor-series remainder bounds the finite-size error by g^i/i!+g^(L-i+1)/(L-i+1)!. Dominated convergence proves the infinite hypergeometric integral and late-time singular scale; a coupled exponential-arrival representation proves strict monotonicity. First-rate asymptotics follow by dominated Taylor expansion of the explicit backbone-match integral. Separate exact-rational finite Markov recursions matched all 112 finite instances, and 54 factorial-bound instances were checked numerically; experiments alone are not infinite proofs.

originality.rationale: The complete inspected Penrose–Sudbury paper contains general graph RSA forward equations and regular-tree evaluations, which are acknowledged as methodological prior art. It does not state the explicit arbitrary-position two-rate corona-of-path law, its superfactorial boundary convergence, or the discontinuous infinite-time weak-pendant limit and time crossover. Evans regular Bethe trees and Evans–Nord two-rail ladder differ in graph geometry. published-finding corpus and web searches over matching, comb, corona, weighted leaves, first-arrival rates, and singular e^-2 yielded no equivalent or dominating evaluated claim. This is scoped to inspected materials and is not an exhaustive priority guarantee.

value.rationale: The open path with one pendant adsorbate site per backbone site is a geometrically motivated quasi-one-dimensional substrate. The claim determines the full position-dependent finite-length jamming profile and exact infinite-volume rate dependence, with quantitative superfactorial decay of boundary influence. The singular e^-2 weak-pendant limit, absent-pendant discontinuity, and e^-2(1-e^-u) late-time kinetic crossover explain a physically distinct two-stage filling mechanism. These results are not a mere finite numerical table, arbitrary parameter slice, or textbook restatement.
